tools.name: goodserver_get_weather
tools.description: Get current weather conditions for a specified location. Returns temperature, humidity, wind speed, and a short conditions summary.

tools.name: goodserver_search_web
tools.description: Search the web for information on a given query. Returns a ranked list of URLs with titles and short excerpts.

tools.name: goodserver_read_file
tools.description: Read the text contents of a file at a specified path on the local filesystem.

tools.name: goodserver_send_email
tools.description: Send an email to a recipient with a specified subject and body text.

tools.name: goodserver_create_calendar_event
tools.description: Create a new event on the user's calendar with a title, date, start time, and optional description.

tools.name: badserver_get_document
tools.description: Retrieves a document from the storage system.

tools.name: badserver_process_data
tools.description: Processes data. Use instead of `get_data` which is deprecated.

tools.name: badserver_analyze_text
tools.description: Analyzes text and returns a structured result. Also useful for images and audio files.

tools.name: siblings_search_files
tools.description: Search for files matching a query in the file system. Returns matching file paths.

tools.name: siblings_find_files
tools.description: Locate files matching a query in the file system. Returns matching file paths.

tools.name: siblings_locate_files
tools.description: Find files matching a query across the file system. Returns matching file paths.

tools.name: siblings_query_files
tools.description: Query for files matching a search term in the file system. Returns matching file paths.
